After discussing ideas and possibilities Gareth responded quickly with a written quote and communicated a schedule clearly. The team now includes Gareth's son Jack and they work so well together. Gareth communicated with us each day, always checked we were happy with what they were doing and consulted us when decisions had to be made. In spite of challenging wet weather, they worked incredibly hard, cleared up each day and we are delighted with the end result. We can strongly recommend them as a friendly, reliable, honest, punctual, tidy and hard-working team of experienced landscape gardeners.
